SECTION B (45 marks)
Answer any three questions from this section in the answer booklet provided.

Give five reasons which influenced the migration of the Abagusii into Kenya during
the pre-colonial period. (5 marks)

Discuss five effects of migration and settlement of the Plain Nilotes during the
pre-colonial period. (10 marks)

State five reasons for the Portuguese success in the conquest of the Kenyan coast.
(5 marks)

Explain five social effects of the Indian Ocean Trade on the people of the Kenyan
coast up to 1500 AD. (10 marks)

Give five reasons for the construction of the Uganda railway. (5 marks)

Explain five problems encountered during the construction of the Uganda railway.
(10 marks)

State five factors that facilitated the Mau Mau movement. (5 marks)

Explain five roles played by the trade union movement in the struggle for
independence in Kenya. (10 marks)

SECTION C (30 marks)

Answer any two questions from this section in the answer booklet provided.

the early 1990s. (3 marks)
Describe six achievements of multi-party democracy in Kenya. (12 marks)
State three functions of the Chief Justice in Kenya. (3 marks)
Explain six problems facing Judiciary in Kenya. (12 marks)
State three ways in which the National Government relates with the County
Governments. (3 marks)
Explain six challenges faced by the County Governments in Kenya. (12 marks)

Answer three questions from this section.

(5 marks)

(10 marks)

pre-colonial period. (3 marks)

century, (12 marks)

War until 1917. (3 marks)

State three common characteristics of the Commonwealth member states. (3 marks)

Describe six achievements of the Commonwealth since its formation. (12 marks)
